scenes.title: Sensors and the control unit detect a severe crash
The cushion spreads force and deflates

vo.text: In a severe car crash, an airbag works with your seat belt to cushion you from hard interior surfaces.
vo.speak: In a severe car crash, an airbag works with your seat belt to cushion you from hard interior surfaces.

vo.text: This explanation slows the sequence down; in a real crash, the airbag responds in tens of milliseconds.
vo.speak: This explanation slows the sequence down; in a real crash, the airbag responds in tens of milliseconds.

vo.text: Crash sensors detect the vehicle's sudden deceleration and send that information to the airbag control unit.
vo.speak: Crash sensors detect the vehicle's sudden deceleration and send that information to the airbag control unit.

vo.text: The control unit triggers the airbag only when the crash pattern indicates a severe impact.
vo.speak: The control unit triggers the airbag only when the crash pattern indicates a severe impact.

vo.text: A small igniter then activates a gas generator inside the folded airbag module.
vo.speak: A small igniter then activates a gas generator inside the folded airbag module.

vo.text: The generator rapidly produces gas that flows into the woven fabric cushion.
vo.speak: The generator rapidly produces gas that flows into the woven fabric cushion.

vo.text: The expanding airbag spreads out in front of the occupant, distributing force over a wider area.
vo.speak: The expanding airbag spreads out in front of the occupant, distributing force over a wider area.

vo.text: As you press into the cushion, vents let gas escape so the airbag can absorb motion while deflating.
vo.speak: As you press into the cushion, vents let gas escape so the airbag can absorb motion while deflating.

vo.text: So the airbag protects by sensing a crash, inflating quickly, and then yielding in a controlled way.
vo.speak: So the airbag protects by sensing a crash, inflating quickly, and then yielding in a controlled way.
